title: One-electron model
hints: Count electrons from the atomic number and charge.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: $\ce{He+}$ has two protons and one electron, unlike neutral helium or the other listed species.
statement:
For which species is the Bohr one-electron energy expression, with proper Z, appropriate?

[_]{a}

explanations: It is a one-electron ion with $Z=2$.
Lithium has three protons and this ion has two electrons.
The extra electron gives two electrons.
